newsitem.title: POLAND: POLL - Polish call rate seen down to 9.1 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Polish call rate seen down to 9.1 pct in Dec.

text.p: The average rate on call deposits in Poland should fall to 9.1 percent at year-end and 8.5 percent at end-June 1998 from the current 9.6 percent, a monthly poll by daily Dziennik Prawa i Gospodarki said.
The poll on Monday of over a dozen large banks said the 12-month consumer credit rate should fall to 24.5 percent at year-end and 23.1 percent at end-June from the current 25.4 percent.
It said rates on 12-month deposits should fall to 18.7 percent at year-end and 16.2 percent at end-June 1998 from the current 19.4 percent.
